pages.text: Ice and Fire integration. General upgrade, maximum level 1. Place one Ice and Fire sapphire in each of five ingredient slots. Costs one upgrade slot. In cold biomes or powder snow, each durability loss has a 70% chance to be prevented.
Melee and harvesting tools: +10% melee damage, 5 seconds of Frost on hit, +40% mining speed and at least iron harvest level for suitable blocks. Ranged tools and staffs: +0.05 accuracy.

Each equipped upgraded armor piece or held shield grants +0.10 knockback resistance and +2 armor toughness. When hurt, roll once for a 30% chance to inflict Frost on the attacker for 3 seconds. Bonuses stop outside the cold.
